name: NJ Reputation & Ecosystem Interest

scope: Discover New Jersey startups with attributable reputation and ecosystem-interest evidence.

phases.name: verify_evidence
requirements: keep event date separate from publication/observation dates

continuation: Internal targeted searches only. Do not stop at a relationship mention or repeatedly ask the user to continue.
completion: Return the scoped candidate cards plus supported sector groupings or a clear evidence shortfall within a bounded run.
guardrails: Association is not proof of commercial success
Institutional affiliation is not necessarily an endorsement
Missing mentions do not prove low attention
Rising attention requires comparable observations over time
provenance_policy: Use only authorized permissioned data; simulated/sample evidence stays labeled and excluded from real-company validation.
